directive: Re-solve thm:high-smoothness-density-robustness without overwriting def:density-adaptive-handle, which must remain the low-smoothness collision/occupancy handle used by oeq:arbitrary-density-frontier and the spectral/grid consumers. Introduce a separate high-smoothness-only HOIF construction with the explicit sample map from the prior attempt, under the domain t>d/2 that permits d/(2t)<gamma<1 and finite Neumann order q. Make the cell-local basis span contain constants; do not claim a global constant basis vector is itself cell-supported. Specify deterministic split, rounding, and tie choices; use valid TeX. Prove finiteness of the deterministic class-oracle variance envelope Vstar and describe it as an oracle calibration constant, not a computable data-derived threshold. Synchronize all inbound edges, symbols, and obligations so the rough frontier retains its collision handle and the high-smoothness theorem consumes only the new handle. Preserve the same SCoDiTE target and derive the exact product-residual identity without adding feature-map or design-density smoothness.
